fnol_text: My name is Esther Haddad and I live at 307 Cedar Terrace, Clinton, NC 28346. You can reach me on (555) 714-2353 or esther.haddad@example.com. On 20 September 2023 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2023-00080. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Haddad on (555) 714-2353 to acknowledge the claim. Esther confirmed the loss date as 20 September 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Ingrid Gallagher gave a statement by phone.
Esther sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
